goal: GAP SWEEP (wave 5b): every listed depth_target is currently not_simulated/config_only in the shipped console. Build each one on a REAL backend (Nano + offline) and lift its capability level to full or limited. 'Out of Vyomi's scope', 'separate product', 'single-account' or 'not modeled' are NOT acceptable reasons: model it in the shared core (Python core/*_core.py, vendored to wasm), wire it through the native wire, enforce behaviour (not stored config), and make the console section live. Only leave a target not_simulated if it needs something physically impossible in a local simulator (real external hardware, real money, a real third-party service) — and then write that concrete reason. config_only targets must become enforced (the setting changes observable behaviour). Update core/capabilities, tests/conformance, ui-spec mapping and smoke where relevant.
note: WAVE 5b gap sweep (orchestrator). Approved by the user: finish all the gaps with real backends.

depth_targets.title: Static website hosting
depth_targets.current_reason: Put/Get/DeleteBucketWebsite store and return the index/error-document configuration verbatim, but static website hosting serves GET/HEAD over a separate bucket-name.s3-website-<region>.amazonaws.com HTTP origin; Vyomi's native wire is a single S3 control+data endpoint and does not run a per-bucket website origin, so that serving path does not exist.

depth_targets.title: Event notifications
depth_targets.current_reason: Offline appliance: events are delivered to the configured SQS queues, SNS topics and Lambda functions in this simulator (ObjectCreated, ObjectRemoved, DeleteMarkerCreated, TestEvent). Nano: the configuration is stored and returned, but events are not delivered yet.

depth_targets.title: Transfer acceleration
depth_targets.current_reason: Transfer acceleration only changes the network path (ingest via a CloudFront edge location) to the same S3 API — there is no behavioural difference for a client to observe, so there is nothing for a single-endpoint simulator to enforce or differentiate.

depth_targets.title: Requester pays
depth_targets.current_reason: Put/GetBucketRequestPayment store and return the Payer setting (BucketOwner/Requester), but Requester Pays changes who is billed for data transfer and requests; Vyomi has no request-identity or billing model, so there is no payer to attribute cost to and no billing behaviour changes.

depth_targets.title: Intelligent-Tiering Archive configurations
depth_targets.current_reason: Put/Get/List/DeleteBucketIntelligentTieringConfiguration store and return each named configuration verbatim, but Intelligent-Tiering archive configurations move objects between access tiers automatically based on 30/90+ day access-pattern windows; Vyomi does not run a long-horizon storage-class scheduler, so no object ever actually transitions tier.

depth_targets.title: Inventory configurations
depth_targets.current_reason: Put/Get/List/DeleteBucketInventoryConfiguration store and return each named configuration verbatim, but inventory configurations run on a daily/weekly schedule and write a CSV/ORC/Parquet manifest of bucket contents to a destination bucket; Vyomi has no scheduler producing those exports.

depth_targets.title: Metrics
depth_targets.current_reason: Put/Get/List/DeleteBucketMetricsConfiguration store and return each named request-metrics filter verbatim, but request/storage filter metrics publish to CloudWatch on a recurring schedule; Vyomi does not run a CloudWatch metrics pipeline for S3, so no metric data points are ever produced.
depth_targets.hint: telemetry: emit real metrics/logs from the simulated engine (wave-6 Prometheus/OTel are the offline sinks once landed; until then derive real series from actual API activity in the core) — never synthetic random data
